# Kautusan Blg. 01, Series of 1993

**Ordinance regarding collection of ferry fees during the Bayan Fiesta.**

## Summary

This ordinance directs the collection of ferry fees from peryantes (ferry owners) during the Bayan Fiesta, setting the period for collection from January 15 to January 31. It specifies that the fees collected in 1994 will remain the same as the previous year and will be used to maintain the health center. A penalty of P200.00 will be imposed for late payments after January 31.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Pangkat I:** All ferry fees collected in 1994 for the Bayan Fiesta will remain the same as the previous year and will be used to maintain the health center. The collection period is from January 15-31.
2.  **Pangkat II:** The payment of ferry fees should be made to the person in charge of the maintenance of the health center.
3.  **Pangkat III:** Any ferry owner who fails to pay the fee will be fined P200.00 after January 31.
4.  **Pangkat IV:** Any ordinance that contradicts this ordinance is repealed.
5.  **Pangkat V:** The ordinance takes effect immediately upon approval by the [[Sangguniang Panlalawigan]].
